units.source_text: 两人谈了些闲话之后，薰大将觉得浮舟之事不必过分隐讳，便开言道：

en.t: After the two had exchanged some casual talk, the Great Captain Kaoru felt that there was no need to conceal the matter of Ukifune too deeply, and began to speak.

units.source_text: “自昔以来，我每逢有事隐藏在心而暂时不对你说，便觉非常难过。

en.t: Ever since long ago, whenever I have kept something hidden in my heart and for a time not told you, I have felt terribly distressed.

units.source_text: 现在我侥幸而升官晋爵，你身居高位，更是少有闲暇，从容谈话的机会竟没有了。

en.t: Now, by good fortune, I have risen in office and rank, and you hold a high position, so there is even less leisure, and chances to talk calmly have disappeared altogether.

units.source_text: 并无特别事由，我也不敢前来拜访，不知不觉间过了多时。

en.t: With no particular reason to come, I did not dare visit you, and before I knew it a long time had passed.

units.source_text: 今天告诉你一件事：你曾到过的宇治山庄中那个短命而死的大女公子，有一个同一血统的人，居住在意想不到的地方。

en.t: Today I will tell you one thing: the elder lady at the Uji mountain villa you once visited, who died young, had a woman of the same bloodline living in an unexpected place.

units.source_text: 我闻知了，就常常去看她，想对她加以照拂。

en.t: When I learned of this, I often went to see her and wished to look after her.

units.source_text: 但当时我方新婚，深恐平白地受人讥议，便把此女寄养在那荒僻的宇治山庄中。

en.t: But at the time I was newly married, and fearing needless criticism, I placed the girl in care at that desolate Uji mountain villa.

units.source_text: 我并不常去看她。

en.t: I did not go to see her often.

units.source_text: 她似乎也不想专心依靠我一人。

en.t: She too seemed not to wish to rely wholeheartedly on me alone.

units.source_text: 如果我要把她当作高贵的正夫人，当然不能让她如此。

en.t: If I had meant to treat her as a noble principal wife, of course I could not have left her in such a state.

units.source_text: 但我并无此心。

en.t: But I had no such intention.

units.source_text: 而看看她的模样，也并无特别缺陷。

en.t: And when I looked at her appearance and manner, there was no particular flaw in her.

units.source_text: 因此我安心地怜爱她。

en.t: So I cherished her with an easy heart.

units.source_text: 岂知最近忽然死去。

en.t: Who could have known that she would suddenly die recently?

units.source_text: 我想起世间诸事无常，不胜悲痛。

en.t: When I think how all things in this world are impermanent, I am overcome with grief.

units.source_text: 此事想必你也闻知了吧。”

en.t: You must surely have heard of this matter too.

units.source_text: 此时他也忍不住流下泪来。

en.t: At this point he too could not hold back and shed tears.

units.source_text: 他并不想叫匂亲王看到他悲伤，便觉不好意思。

en.t: He did not want Prince Niou to see his grief, and felt embarrassed.

units.source_text: 然而眼泪一经出眶，便无法制止，脸色有些狼狈。

en.t: Yet once the tears had left his eyes, he could not stop them, and his face looked somewhat discomposed.

units.source_text: 匂亲王想：“他的态度异乎寻常，大约已经知道我的事情了吧？

en.t: Prince Niou thought, His manner is extraordinary; perhaps he already knows about my affair.

units.source_text: 真遗憾。”

en.t: What a pity.

units.source_text: 但仍若无其事地说道：“这真是可悲之事。

en.t: But he still said as if nothing were wrong, This is truly a sad matter.

units.source_text: 我昨天也曾约略闻知。

en.t: I too heard something of it yesterday.

units.source_text: 曾想派人前来慰问，探询情状。

en.t: I thought of sending someone to offer sympathy and ask about the circumstances.

units.source_text: 但因听说这是足下决意不欲使人知道之事，故未奉访耳。”

en.t: But because I heard that this was something you were determined not to let others know, I refrained from calling.

units.source_text: 他装作漠不关心地说，然而心中悲伤不堪，因此语甚寥寥。

en.t: He spoke while pretending indifference, but his heart was unbearably sorrowful, and so his words were very few.

units.source_text: 薰大将说：“因为她与我关系如此，所以我也想推荐与你。

en.t: The Great Captain Kaoru said, Because her connection with me was as I have described, I had also thought of recommending her to you.

units.source_text: 但你自然已经见过了吧？

en.t: But naturally you had already seen her, had you not?

units.source_text: 她不是曾经到过你府上么？”

en.t: Did she not once go to your residence?

units.source_text: 这话中略有暗示。

en.t: There was a slight hint in these words.

units.source_text: 继而又说：“你身心欠安之时，我对你说这些无甚意味的世事，有渎清听，实甚冒昧。

en.t: Then he went on, At a time when you are unwell in body and mind, it is truly presumptuous of me to trouble you with these meaningless worldly matters.

units.source_text: 务望保重为要。”

en.t: Please make taking care of yourself your first concern.

units.source_text: 他说过这话就告辞而去。

en.t: After saying this, he took his leave and departed.

units.source_text: 归途上想道：“他思念得好厉害啊！

en.t: On the way home he thought, How intensely he longs for her!

units.source_text: 浮舟不幸短命而死，然而宿命生成是个高贵之人。

en.t: Ukifune was unfortunate and died young, yet by fate she was born a noble person.

units.source_text: 这匂亲王是当代皇上、皇后异常宠爱的皇子。

en.t: This Prince Niou is a prince especially beloved by the present emperor and empress.

units.source_text: 自颜貌姿态以至一切，在现今世间都是出类拔萃的。

en.t: From his looks and bearing to everything else, he is outstanding in the present world.

units.source_text: 他的夫人都不是寻常人，在各方面都是高贵无比的淑女。

en.t: His wives are not ordinary people either, but ladies of incomparable nobility in every respect.

units.source_text: 但他撇开了她们而倾心热爱这浮舟。

en.t: Yet he put them aside and gave his heart in passionate love to this Ukifune.

units.source_text: 现在世人大肆骚扰，举办祈祷、诵经、祭祀、祓禊，各处都忙得不可开交，其实都是为了匂亲王悼念此女而生病之故。

en.t: Now everyone is in a great commotion, holding prayers, sutra recitations, rites, and purifications, and every place is overwhelmed with activity; in truth it is all because Prince Niou has fallen ill from mourning this woman.

units.source_text: 我也是个高贵之人，娶得当今皇家公主为夫人。

en.t: I too am a noble person, and I have taken a princess of the present imperial house as my wife.

units.source_text: 我对浮舟的悼念，何曾不及匂亲王之深？

en.t: How could my mourning for Ukifune ever be less deep than Prince Niou's?

units.source_text: 如今想起她已死去，悲伤之情无法制止呢！

en.t: Now, when I think that she has died, I cannot restrain my grief.

units.source_text: 虽说如此，这等悲伤实在是愚笨的。

en.t: Even so, grief like this is truly foolish.

units.source_text: 但愿不再如此。”

en.t: I hope I will not be like this again.

units.source_text: 他努力抑制哀情，然而还是左思右想，心绪缭乱。

en.t: He struggled to suppress his sorrow, yet he still kept turning thoughts over and over, his mind in confusion.

units.source_text: 便独自吟诵白居易“人非木石皆有情……”之诗，躺卧在那里。

en.t: Then he lay there alone, chanting Bai Juyi's poem, People are not wood or stone; all have feelings.

units.source_text: 想起浮舟死后葬仪非常简单，不知她的姐姐二女公子闻知后作何感想，薰大将觉得很对人不起，又很不安心。

en.t: Remembering that Ukifune's funeral after her death had been very simple, and wondering what her elder sister, the Second Lady, would think when she heard of it, Kaoru felt deeply apologetic and uneasy.

units.source_text: 他想：“她的母亲身份低微。

en.t: He thought, Her mother's rank is low.

units.source_text: 此种阶层的人家有一种迷信：有兄弟的人死后葬仪必须简单，因此草率了事吧。”

en.t: Families of that class have a superstition that when someone with siblings dies, the funeral must be simple, so they must have handled it carelessly.

units.source_text: 思之心甚不快。

en.t: Thinking of this made his heart very uncomfortable.

units.source_text: 宇治情况如何，他所不悉者甚多。

en.t: There was much he did not know about how things stood at Uji.

units.source_text: 为欲知道浮舟死时的情状，他想亲自赴宇治探问。

en.t: Wanting to know the circumstances of Ukifune's death, he wished to go to Uji himself and inquire.

units.source_text: 然而在那边长留，实非所宜。

en.t: Yet it would truly not be proper to stay there for long.

units.source_text: 如去了立刻回来，又觉于心不忍。

en.t: If he went and came back at once, that too felt more than his heart could bear.

units.source_text: 心中犹豫不决，不胜烦恼。

en.t: In his heart he wavered and could not decide, overwhelmed by distress.
